cim_eredeti: Building 3D video sets with GPT-6.2 Astra
szoveg_eredeti:
GPT-6.2 Astra is our new flagship model, delivering a step up in capability with cleaner code, better frontends and 3D models, and more efficient tool use.

Recreate a room from just two video frames with GPT-6.2 Astra in Codex. See how it builds the set in Blender, changes the decor and lighting, and turns the scene into an interactive space and a virtual webcam background.
